tropical_outlook: No tropical threat to any Week 4 venue. As of Sept 29 the NHC is tracking Tropical Storm Hanna (central subtropical Atlantic, ~45 mph, moving east, expected post-tropical by late week), Tropical Depression Fay (27.1N 44.6W, 35 mph, mid-Atlantic, no land threat) and Invest 91L in the open Atlantic. The 2026 season has been very quiet (strong El Nino). Nothing is forecast to approach Tampa, Charlotte, Houston or the mid-Atlantic this weekend. Houston's 70% rain chance is from a frontal/Gulf-moisture pattern (1-4 in. regionwide Tue-Sun), not a tropical system. A 'tropical system off the East Coast threatening MNF in Miami' article surfaced in results but is from the 2025 season and was discarded.

2026_04_PIT_CLE.conditions: Warm, humid start (Thu high near 82), mostly cloudy with showers likely developing after 8pm; temps falling through the 60s during the game
2026_04_PIT_CLE.notes: NWS Cleveland 7-day: Thursday partly sunny high ~82, showers likely after 8pm (60%), low ~62, NW wind ~9 mph. A cold front arrives late Wed/Thu per Fox 8; rain could arrive during 2nd half. Wind not expected to be a major factor but lakefront gusts to ~20 mph possible behind the front. Snow/rain 'Steelers-Browns' articles in results are from Nov 2024 and were discarded.

2026_04_IND_WAS.conditions: Sunny intervals, dry, mild; high ~20C/68F, gusts to ~13 mph
2026_04_IND_WAS.notes: Met Office/long-range: Sunday 4 Oct max 20C, min 11C, rain probability <5%, max gust 13 mph. Tottenham's roof is normally open for NFL games; with a dry forecast expect open roof. Kickoff 2:30pm local so temperature near the daily high.

2026_04_TEN_BAL.conditions: Mostly cloudy, showers likely, possible thunderstorm; high near 70; WNW wind ~9 mph with gusts to ~20 mph
2026_04_TEN_BAL.notes: NWS Baltimore: showers likely and possibly a thunderstorm Sunday, 60% chance, high near 70. A secondary source shows rain all day (100%), 66/62 with WNW 9 mph gusting 22. Wet-field game is a real possibility; wind moderate.

2026_04_NE_BUF.conditions: Partly cloudy, 50% chance of showers, high ~70, light SW wind ~5 mph
2026_04_NE_BUF.notes: Mild for Orchard Park in early October; light wind so passing game unaffected. Showers possible but not a washout per current forecast. Forecast is 5 days out and may change.

2026_04_NYJ_CHI.conditions: Cool, cloudy with patchy light rain showers possible; high near 59-62
2026_04_NYJ_CHI.notes: Only long-range aggregator data found (high ~15C/59F, patchy rain). No NWS/local TV specifics for Oct 4 surfaced in searches; a targeted Bears-Jets search returned only January 2026 playoff articles. Chicago climatology for Oct 4 is high ~66, low ~48, avg wind ~10 mph; lakefront breeze possible. Treat numbers as provisional and re-check closer to kickoff.

2026_04_JAX_CIN.conditions: Mild, mostly cloudy, 35% shower chance at kickoff dropping to ~25% by mid-afternoon; N/ENE wind ~7 mph, gusts 12-14
2026_04_JAX_CIN.notes: Game-window forecast: 65F at noon rising to 68F by 3-4pm. Sources disagree on Sunday rain: AccuWeather shows scattered thunderstorms high ~70, while a long-range aggregator shows heavy rain (93%). Game-specific hourly forecast is the more credible source; some rain risk but not a high-wind game.

2026_04_DAL_HOU.conditions: Showers and thunderstorms likely, mostly cloudy, high near 83, humid
2026_04_DAL_HOU.notes: NWS Houston: 70% chance of showers/storms Sunday, high ~83; off-and-on storms Tue through Sun with 1-4 in. regional rainfall. NRG roof is closed for nearly all Texans home games and certainly will be with rain in the forecast, so effectively indoor conditions. Not tropical in origin.

2026_04_ARI_NYG.conditions: Cloudy, chance of rain, high 65-67; light wind
2026_04_ARI_NYG.notes: ABC7/AccuWeather: some rain possible Sunday, high ~67 (Jersey City 65/55). Local forecasters explicitly call the Sunday outlook uncertain, hinging on the position of a nearby front and moisture return. Nor'easter articles in results refer to an earlier event, not this weekend.

2026_04_LA_PHI.conditions: Overcast with light rain developing in the morning, moderate rain in the afternoon, clearing by evening; high ~65, humid
2026_04_LA_PHI.notes: Two sources agree on rain Sunday (65/59, ~68% chance) with the heaviest during the 1pm-4pm game window. Same frontal system affecting Baltimore and NJ; wet-ball conditions likely, wind moderate.

2026_04_GB_TB.conditions: Hot and humid, partly cloudy to overcast, scattered showers/storms possible; high mid-80s to near 90, low ~77
2026_04_GB_TB.notes: No game-specific forecast published yet (NFLWeather shows 'coming soon'). General long-range sources disagree: one shows overcast with 100% rain chance (86/77, ~9 mm, wind 11 mph), another shows passing showers at 59%. Heat index will exceed 90 at 1pm kickoff regardless. Typical early-October Tampa pattern: afternoon scattered storms. No tropical system nearby. Hoodline/WFLA 'dry Sunday gameday' pieces were about Sept 27 and were discarded.

2026_04_LAC_SEA.conditions: Intervals of clouds and sun, dry, high ~69, N wind 5-10 mph
2026_04_LAC_SEA.notes: Pleasant fall day; no precipitation expected, light wind. Kickoff 1:25pm local near the daily high. Overnight low 52.

2026_04_DEN_SF.conditions: Sunny and warm, high near 88, light wind; clear overnight low ~61
2026_04_DEN_SF.notes: NWS Santa Clara zone forecast: sunny, high ~88. Warm for Denver in a 1:25pm local kickoff (sun-exposed east side); no wind or rain factor.

2026_04_DET_CAR.conditions: Overcast, humid, isolated evening thunderstorms possible; daytime high ~76, falling to upper 60s during the 8:20pm game; light wind
2026_04_DET_CAR.notes: Long-range aggregator: isolated thunderstorms, 76/63, 79% precip chance (0.72 in.), wind 4 mph, humidity 70%. No local TV/NWS specifics for Sunday night found in searches. Night kickoff usually lowers convective risk versus afternoon; no tropical involvement. Re-check Friday/Saturday.
